title: Speaking — Planning a meal
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on planning a meal.

questions: Where do you usually spend time with friends?
How do you keep in touch with friends you rarely see?
What kinds of activities do you normally do together?
Do you prefer meeting one friend or a group?
What do you consider when choosing a meal for several people?
Do you plan meals before you shop?

part2.topic: Describe a meal you helped arrange for a group.
points: what decisions you had to make
part2.closing: and explain what you would do differently if you did it again.

questions: How can social meals help people from different backgrounds get to know one another?
Why has eating alone become more common in some places?
How has everyday life connected with planning a meal changed for people of different ages?
